# Diego Gaboardi

> Senior Software Developer at PTC, based in Vienna, Austria. Builds AI-powered products, from computer vision and augmented reality to LLM-powered applications such as Windchill AI Assistant.

## Links
- [Website](https://gaboardidiego.github.io/personal-website/): portfolio (client-rendered; structured data in JSON-LD)
- [CV (PDF)](https://gaboardidiego.github.io/personal-website/cv/diego-gaboardi-cv.pdf)
- [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/diego-gaboardi)
- Email: gaboardidiego@gmail.com

## Experience
- 2025 to present, Senior Software Developer, PTC Windchill: contributed to Windchill AI Assistant from prototypes to release (frontend and backend); OpenAI models and APIs; automatic indexing of Windchill data with Azure AI Services. Java.
- 2023 to 2025, Senior Software Developer, PTC Vuforia: cloud services team; AWS-hosted WebAPIs (Python/FastAPI, TypeScript/NestJS, Scala); Kubernetes, Prometheus, Grafana, Argo, FluxCD, Helm; CI migration from TeamCity to GitHub Actions.
- 2019 to 2023, Software Developer, PTC Vuforia: AR SDK (C++), benchmarking test framework (Python), migration of benchmarks to Azure, ground-truth generation pipelines.
- 2018, thesis with Politecnico di Milano and Piaggio: computer-vision collision avoidance for motorbikes.
- 2017, TUM and BMW mobility services project: FleetMe, corporate fleet optimization.

## Education
- Politecnico di Milano, Master's degree with honors (2016-2018); Bachelor's degree (2013-2016)
- Technical University of Munich, semester abroad (2017-2018)

## Languages
English (fluent), Italian (native), German (basic)
